description: The machine-readable source of truth. Prose documentation is generated from this file; TypeScript types are generated from this file; CI validates against this file. Nothing is authoritative except this file.

forbidden_name_patterns.reason: Version suffixes in names. Mint a new semantic name instead.
Test artifact in a production plan.
UI element in an event name. Track the transition, not the widget.

conventions.name_exceptions_reason: GA4 recommended ecommerce and lead event names. Mapping to the platform's own vocabulary preserves its built-in reporting; inventing a parallel custom event fragments it. Exempt from the verb rule only.
conventions.enum_value_pattern_note: Lowercase snake_case. A leading digit is permitted only for banded ranges such as 1_10 or 5k_25k.

ga4.note: Google truncates rather than errors. Nothing in the UI reports a breach. This is why the limits are enforced here.

budgets.unbounded_non_id_note: Identifier properties ending in _id are explicit join keys and are exempt. Anything else unbounded is free text in disguise.

events.name: signup_completed
events.description: A user row was committed and the account is usable. Not on form submit, not on verification email dispatch. Idempotent on user_id.
events.trigger: POST /v1/signup returns 201 and the transaction commits
events.decision: Determines acquisition spend allocation and the top of every conversion funnel.

events.name: account_created
events.description: A billable entity came into existence. Distinct from signup_completed: one account accumulates many users, and in a sales-led motion the account is provisioned before any user exists.
events.trigger: Account row committed
events.decision: The denominator for every account-scoped cohort, retention curve and activation rate.

events.name: trial_started
events.description: A time-limited trial of a paid tier began.
events.trigger: Trial record created on the subscription
events.decision: Trial volume and mix drive the paid-conversion forecast.

events.name: subscription_started
events.description: First paid subscription on the account. Fires on the billing provider's confirmed activation webhook, never on checkout submit.
events.trigger: Stripe customer.subscription.created with status=active
events.decision: New MRR. Reconciled monthly against the billing system with a 0.5% tolerance.

events.name: subscription_upgraded
events.description: Movement to a higher tier, or a seat increase that raises MRR.
events.trigger: Subscription update webhook where mrr_delta > 0
events.decision: Expansion MRR, the numerator of net revenue retention.

events.name: subscription_cancelled
events.description: Cancellation requested. Access usually continues until period end, which is subscription_expired. Conflating the two is the most common churn-reporting error there is.
events.trigger: Subscription cancel_at_period_end set, or immediate cancellation
events.decision: Leading churn indicator and the trigger for the save-offer motion.

events.name: payment_failed
events.description: An invoice payment attempt failed. Involuntary churn is typically 20-40% of total churn and is the only kind that is fully recoverable.
events.trigger: Stripe invoice.payment_failed
events.decision: Drives the dunning sequence. The highest-ROI event in most SaaS plans.

events.name: activation_reached
events.description: The account met the activation definition. See definitions.activation for the versioned criteria. Emitted by a scheduled evaluator, not by the application path.
events.trigger: Nightly evaluator detects all criteria met within the 14-day window
events.decision: The single most-quoted number in the company. Influences trial conversion, expansion and churn forecasts.

events.name: user_identified
events.description: Binds anonymous_id to user_id. Fires ONCE per binding, server-side. Firing per page load merges unrelated users through shared devices and corrupts every cohort built afterwards.
events.trigger: First authenticated request after an anonymous session
events.decision: Determines whether pre-signup behaviour can be joined to post-signup outcomes at all.

events.name: pipeline_created
events.description: A pipeline row was committed. Criterion 1 of the activation definition.
events.trigger: POST /v1/pipelines returns 201
events.decision: First value moment. Drives onboarding design.

events.name: deal_stage_changed
events.description: A deal moved between pipeline stages. Replaces seven per-stage events; adding an eighth stage requires no taxonomy change.
events.trigger: Deal stage field updated and committed
events.decision: Stage velocity and conversion, the core analytical surface of the product.

events.name: member_added
events.description: A user joined the account as a member. Criterion 2 of the activation definition.
events.trigger: Membership row committed
events.decision: Multiplayer rate, the strongest single retention predictor in the product.

events.name: invite_sent
events.description: One or more invitations dispatched. recipient_domain_matches_account is a domain comparison; no address is ever carried.
events.trigger: Invite records committed and dispatched
events.decision: Viral coefficient and the design of the invite surface.

events.name: integration_connected
events.description: An integration link was established and verified. One event covers all 19 providers; adding a twentieth is a registry row, not a taxonomy change.
events.trigger: OAuth callback verified and connection row committed
events.decision: Integration attach rate. Criterion 4 of the activation definition since v2026.2.

events.name: onboarding_step_completed
events.description: One onboarding step resolved, with one of three outcomes. Replaces 18 per-step events across three flows; reordering steps requires no change.
events.trigger: Step resolves as completed, skipped or failed
events.decision: Where the onboarding flow leaks, and which step to fix first.

events.name: feature_gate_blocked
events.description: A user attempted an action their plan does not permit. The highest-intent expansion signal in the plan.
events.trigger: Authorisation check fails on a tier-gated capability
events.decision: Feeds the live upgrade queue. Five blocks across two gates in 28 days is a sales conversation.

events.name: lead_captured
events.description: A marketing form produced a lead record. Server-side because it reconciles with the CRM and because client-side form tracking loses 15-30% to blockers. Carries no address, name or free text.
events.trigger: Form handler creates or updates the CRM record
events.decision: Marketing-sourced pipeline and paid media optimisation.

events.name: page_view
events.description: A page or SPA route rendered. Exactly one per route; enhanced measurement page views are disabled to prevent duplication.
events.trigger: Initial load, or history change after the route settles
events.decision: Content strategy and funnel entry analysis.

events.name: cta_clicked
events.description: A call to action was clicked. Matched on the data-analytics-id attribute contract, never on a CSS selector, so redesigns do not break it.
events.trigger: Click on any element carrying data-analytics-id
events.decision: Placement and copy decisions on the marketing site.

events.name: export_completed
events.description: Data left the system in a user-requested format. Replaces 12 per-format-per-surface events.
events.trigger: Export job finishes and the file is delivered
events.decision: Whether export is a stickiness feature or a churn signal. Scheduled exports indicate embedded workflows.

events.name: feature_used
events.description: A registered feature performed its core action. feature_id is validated against feature_registry in CI. One event family for the entire roadmap.
events.trigger: Feature core action completes
events.decision: Adoption depth, breadth-vs-depth segmentation, power-user identification.

events.name: consent_state_set
events.description: Consent state was established or changed. Captured client-side and persisted server-side, because a consent record is a legal artifact you must be able to produce on request. Also makes a consent shift visible as a consent shift rather than an unexplained traffic drop.
events.trigger: Consent default applied, or user decision recorded
events.decision: Segments every other metric by consent state, and evidences the implementation if a regulator asks.

events.name: api_error_returned
events.description: The API returned an error. endpoint_pattern is templated; populated paths carry identifiers and explode cardinality.
events.trigger: Response status >= 400
events.decision: Reliability prioritisation and support-load forecasting.

events.name: ai_summary_requested
events.description: A user asked the assistant to summarise a deal. Experimental: promoted with evidence of use by the expiry date, or deleted.
events.trigger: POST /v1/ai/summary accepted
events.decision: Whether the AI summary feature earns a place in the activation definition.

events.name: workspace_created
events.description: Renamed to pipeline_created when the product settled on 'pipeline' as the user-facing term. Dual-running until sunset; do not add new references.
events.trigger: Pipeline row committed
events.decision: Superseded. Retained only so historical comparisons remain valid through the migration.

versions.derivation: Cohort analysis of 4180 accounts created 2025-07 to 2025-12. Accounts meeting all four criteria retained at 68% at week 12; accounts meeting two or fewer retained at 19%.
Superseded: CRM-connected accounts showed a 22-point retention gap at matched usage levels, so crm_connected was added as criterion 4.

feature_adoption.default_rule: 3 uses across 2 distinct days within 14 days of first use

onboarding_abandonment.note: No step event for the flow within the window. Changing this window silently changes every historical abandonment rate; treat it as a versioned definition.
